paper_id: Pretraining Chinese BERT for Detecting Word Insertion and Deletion Errors
title: Pretraining Chinese BERT for Detecting Word Insertion and Deletion Errors
motivation: Chinese BERT fails on word insertion/deletion because BERT assumes every position has a word, yet these errors account for 44.7% of grammatical errors
problem_framing: Detect whether a word should be inserted between positions or deleted at a position in Chinese text lacking word delimiters
key_insight: Introduce [null] token whose prediction represents non-existence of a word; jointly train with substitution and insertion corruption operations
method_signature: Chinese BERT pretrained with [null] token added to vocabulary for word insertion/deletion detection via masked language modeling
evaluation_criteria: Character-level precision/recall/F1 for detection; end-to-end position+word accuracy for correction
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Speed-up attempt inserting [mask] between all word pairs improves speed 10x but decreases F1 from 78.1 to 72.3
evidence_for_taste: BERT assumes the existence of a word at each position
the learning objective of BERT assumes the existence of a word
predict [null] at the position of x̃ins means that there is no word
we do not insert [mask] tokens to the input
detecting all tokens can be done in one forward pass
our approach consistently outperforms baselines by large margins
thinking_moves: 把BERT假设'每个位置必须有词'变成可学习的约束条件
通过加入null token让模型同时具备'选词'和'判断词是否存在'两种能力
用同一模型同一前向传播同时完成检测和纠正
先验证简单方案(BERT w/ inserted [mask])的局限性，再提出改进
承认精度-速度权衡，不回避实用性问题
